items.source:
This package contains interfaces and annotations relative to object-json mapping and the notion of a Couchbase
Storable.
items.translation: 该包包含与对象 - JSON 映射以及 Couchbase 可存储概念相关的接口和注解。

items.source:
capture the indexCreator when it has been added as a listener. only publishEvent() if the indexCreator hasn't
already seen the class.
items.translation: 在将 indexCreator 添加为监听器时捕获它。仅当 indexCreator 尚未见过该类时才调用 publishEvent()。
CouchbasePersistentEntityIndexCreator 在 org.springframework.data.couchbase.core.mapping 中的用途
